items.title: Buildforce raises $10M Series A to staff electricians nationally
items.note: Saepio-led round backs the largest tech-enabled electrician staffing platform as it expands across the US

items.title: AI proptech rollup Dwelly raises $170M Series B
items.note: EQT Growth-led round backs its buy-and-automate strategy for UK letting agencies, total funding tops $260M in under a year

items.title: OpenAI's unreleased Astra model solves 10 decades-old math problems
items.note: Formal Lean proofs published on GitHub for problems open since 1999, cost about $2,000 in API compute per Brockman

items.title: Missouri signs wholesaler disclosure law, effective August 28
items.note: SB 973 requires 14-day advance disclosure before a wholesaler can contract, sellers can cancel and reclaim earnest money

items.title: Ex-Palantir and Torq founders raise $8M to police enterprise AI agents
items.note: Arrakis Security's Hetz Ventures-led seed builds monitoring for autonomous agents acting without human oversight

items.title: Ex-Epsagon founders raise $34M for AI workplace-agent startup Harmony
items.note: Lightspeed-led seed puts AI agents in Slack and Teams to handle IT, HR and finance requests
